content.title: Are You Among the Negligent?
content.subtitle: One Small Act of Worship at Night Can Remove the Label of Negligence!
content.body:
When the noise around us fades and the silence of night sets in, we lean against our pillows and scroll through the dazzling attractions of this world. Some get lost in fleeting social media reels, while others spend their time in meaningless inbox conversations. As the blue light of the screen tires our eyes, we eventually put our phones aside and drift into deep sleep.

The night passes, but we never find the time to speak to the Lord of the heavens.

The Lord who sustains every breath, conceals our countless mistakes and sins, and lovingly shelters us through the night deserves at least a moment of gratitude before we sleep. Spending hours immersed in the illusions of the virtual world while neglecting the words of our Creator is ghaflah, or heedlessness, a serious ailment of the heart. If we are recorded before the Lord of the Throne as heedless servants, what greater loss could there be?

Our Endless Negligence and Our Lord’s Boundless Mercy

Our negligence knows no bounds, yet His forgiveness is immense! Even when a servant turns away from Him, Allah never closes the door of forgiveness. Knowing our exhaustion and weakness, He has not burdened us beyond our capacity. He is ready to forgive and embrace His servants with mercy for even a small act of obedience.

Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

“Whoever recites ten verses while praying at night will not be recorded among the heedless. Whoever recites one hundred verses will be recorded among the devout, and whoever recites one thousand verses will be recorded among those who receive immense rewards.”

(Sunan Abi Dawud: 1398; Sahih)

SubhanAllah! Despite our countless moments of negligence, simply standing in prayer during the quiet of the night and reciting ten verses can keep us from being recorded among the heedless. Where else could we find such immense mercy from our Lord?

Answer Your Lord’s Call and Return to Him Tonight

We may not always have time for lengthy acts of worship, but do we really have an excuse to miss this gift from our Lord?

  • A Small Effort Through Witr or Nafl Prayer: Before sleeping, recite ten verses after Surah Al-Fatihah during Witr, two rak‘ahs of voluntary prayer, or Tahajjud to attain this great reward.

  • The Blessings of Short Surahs: Reciting Surah Al-Fil and Surah Quraysh together, or Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas, easily takes you beyond ten verses.

  • Sleep After Sincere Repentance: Turn off your screen a little earlier and spend a few minutes standing before your Lord. Your heart will feel lighter, and tranquility will settle within you.

Instead of losing the night to fleeting screen entertainment, let us spend its final moments with the words of our Lord. Repent and raise your hands in supplication tonight, so that another night does not pass with your name recorded among the heedless.

footer_button.hint: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said that if all the creations of the seven heavens and seven earths were placed on one side of a scale, and La ilaha illallah on the other, the declaration of Tawheed would outweigh them all. We have taken the initiative to recite this dhikr frequently, aiming to proclaim the Oneness of Allah at least 50 million times! Join thousands of believers in this collective effort. Let us illuminate our daily lives with the light of Tawheed and enrich our records of deeds through this blessed dhikr.
